model_annotation: This chart displays the relative shares (in percent) of various categories across two years—2014 (represented by the inner ring) and 2021 (represented by the outer ring)—using a double-ring (donut) pie chart format. The chart contains approximately 14 categories. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the categories and their respective 2014 (inner) and 2021 (outer) values are: Sport/Erholung at 3.6% (outer) and approximately a corresponding inner share; Wohnungswesen at 7.2% (outer) and 8.4% (inner); Abwasserentsorgung at 7.8% (outer) and 10.2% (inner); Abfallwirtschaft at 3.4% (outer) and 4.0% (inner); Stromversorgung at 8.9% (outer) and 4.2% (inner); Gasversorgung at 1.5% (outer) and 11.8% (inner); Wasserversorgung at 8.8% (outer) and 6.2% (inner); Kombinierte Versorgung at 5.5% (outer) and 6.2% (inner); Übrige Versorgung at 1.3% (outer) and 1.4% (inner); Verkehr at 3.7% (outer) and 4.4% (inner); Wirtschaftsförderung at 4.7% (outer) and 6.2% (inner); Kliniken at 3.2% (outer) and 4.5% (inner); Übrige at 38.1% (outer) and 31.1% (inner); and Kultur at 2.2% (outer) and 2.4% (inner), with an additional value of 4.1% and 1.3% visible near certain segments. Each category is distinguished by a different color, including shades of blue, green, purple, brown, gray, and dark red. Percentage labels are placed directly adjacent to each slice for both rings. The largest segment in both years is "Übrige" (other), shown in a muted brown/gray tone, dominating the chart. No separate legend box is provided; instead, labels are connected to slices via lines. The slices are not exploded or offset, and they appear arranged in a clockwise order around the rings.
